## DISCOVER

### `agents`

List every supported tool SkillSmith detects on this system

Primary question: Which coding tools are detected and what can Skillsmith do with them?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith agents`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (read-only): List only coding tools detected on this machine. — `skillsmith agents --detected-only`
- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Emit the supported-tool capability inventory as JSON. — `skillsmith agents --format json`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--detected-only` — Omit the "Not detected" section
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Narrow the scan to a tool; repeatable

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--capabilities` — Append the selected tools capability matrix

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--format <markdown|json>` — Output format: markdown or json
- `--json` — Emit the versioned agents JSON report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — tool detection completed successfully
- `1` — tool detection failed
- `2` — invalid tool or output selection
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT

### `status`

Correlate desired, locked, ledger, and live skill state

Primary question: How do desired, locked, ledger, and live states relate?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith status`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (read-only): Compare desired, locked, ledger, and live state. — `skillsmith status`
- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Check the Codex review placement and fail when it has drift. — `skillsmith status review --tool codex --check`

#### Arguments

- `[skill...]` — Skill names or exact placement paths

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict status to a target tool; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Restrict status to one installation scope
- `--system` — Shorthand for --scope=system
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--managed` — Shorthand for --scope=managed

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Read desired state from an explicit manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Read an explicit lockfile (requires --file)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--check` — Exit 7 when the selected status product contains drift

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout

#### Exit codes

- `0` — selected status completed successfully
- `1` — status observation failed
- `2` — invalid usage or unmatched target
- `3` — manifest, lock, or ledger state is invalid
- `4` — a required read capability is unavailable
- `5` — a signed source dependency failed
- `6` — a selected path could not be read due to permissions
- `7` — the selected status product contains drift
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


## MANAGE

### `install`

Install agent skills from a git host.

Aliases: `i`

Primary question: How do I acquire and persist a remote skill?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith install <source>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Install factor-scan into user scope. — `skillsmith install smorinlabs/smorinlabs-harness/factor-scan --user`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Install and pin an exact tagged review skill in project scope. — `skillsmith install acme/agent-tools/review@v1.2.0 --project --pin`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Install a nested GitLab skill path for Claude Code. — `skillsmith install gitlab.com/acme/platform/tools//skills/review --tool claude-code`

#### Arguments

- `<source...>` — owner/repo[/name], owner/repo//path, host/owner/repo[/name], or a git URL; append @ref when needed

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — user or project; default: project in a git repo, otherwise user
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Target tool; repeatable; default: all detected

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Use an explicit desired-state manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Use an explicit lockfile (requires --file)
- `--pin` _(advanced)_ — Freeze the resolved commit SHA in the ledger
- `--ref <git-ref>` — Tag, branch, or full SHA; valid with a single source only
- `-p, --path <dir>` _(advanced)_ — Use a custom placement directory for one source and one effective tool

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--deep` — Run static and deep verification before placement
- `--direct` _(advanced)_ — Copy files instead of symlinking from the store
- `--no-save` _(advanced)_ — Change live placement without inspecting or changing portable desired state
- `--no-verify` _(advanced)_ — Skip the verify gate and record that decision in the ledger
- `--strict` — Make verify warnings block installation

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Reinstall, replace, or override cross-scope shadowing
- `-y, --yes` — Approve a multi-group or backup-and-replace install plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Keep going after per-source failures
- `--dry-run` — Print the resolved plan without changing anything
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — installed, or already at the resolved revision
- `1` — verify gate, snapshot, or swap failed; state is recoverable
- `2` — usage error or refusal, including non-interactive ambiguity
- `3` — placements ledger is unreadable
- `4` — requested target tool is unavailable
- `5` — source, repository, revision, or skill is unresolvable
- `6` — skills directory, store, or ledger is not writable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT; state is recoverable


### `uninstall`

Remove installed skills (placements + ledger records; the store is never deleted).

Aliases: `remove`, `rm`

Primary question: How do I remove a skill and its desired-state declaration?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith uninstall <skill>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Remove the selected factor-scan placement. — `skillsmith uninstall factor-scan`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Remove review from project scope. — `skillsmith uninstall review --project`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Use the rm alias to remove Codex review placements across scopes. — `skillsmith rm review --all-scopes --tool codex`

#### Arguments

- `<skill...>` — Installed skill names or placement paths; use scope or tool flags to disambiguate

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all-scopes` _(advanced)_ — Remove from user scope and the current project
- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Restrict removal to user or project scope
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict removal to tools; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Use an explicit desired-state manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Use an explicit lockfile (requires --file)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--no-save` _(advanced)_ — Change live placement without inspecting or changing portable desired state

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Remove dev-mode or unmanaged placements too
- `-y, --yes` — Approve a multi-group or backup-and-replace uninstall plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent declaration groups after a failure
- `--dry-run` — Print removals without executing them
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — removed, or already absent
- `1` — removal failed mid-flight; state is recoverable
- `2` — usage error or refusal, including ambiguous or unmanaged placement
- `3` — placements ledger is unreadable
- `6` — skills directory or ledger is not writable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT; state is recoverable


### `update`

Update selected portable declarations to exact verified revisions

Primary question: How do I check or apply source revision changes?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith update --check`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (preview): Check bounded declarations for newer revisions. — `skillsmith update --check`
- **Focused workflow** (preview): Preview an update of factor-scan. — `skillsmith update factor-scan --dry-run`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Move factor-scan to main and pin the resolved revision. — `skillsmith update factor-scan --ref main --pin`

#### Arguments

- `[skill...]` — Declared skill names or globs; omitted is valid only for bounded check or with --all

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all` — Select every eligible declaration in the chosen manifest
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict each selected declaration to a tool; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Select one explicit portable manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Select one explicit lockfile (requires --file)
- `--ref <git-ref>` — Track one exact branch, tag, or full SHA
- `--pin` _(advanced)_ — Freeze the selected moving ref to its resolved full SHA

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--check` — Exit 7 when a successfully evaluated update is available
- `--strict` — Treat verification warnings or inconclusive results as blocking

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-y, --yes` — Approve an exact multi-declaration update plan

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Render the exact update plan without durable writes
- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent declarations after a failure
- `--json` — Emit the strict update@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — selected declarations are current, skipped, previewed, or updated
- `1` — verification, execution, integrity, or partial update failed
- `2` — invalid selection, option, or approval policy
- `3` — selected manifest, lock, ledger, or execution guard is invalid or stale
- `4` — a required update or selected-tool capability is unavailable
- `5` — a selected source or exact remote ref could not be resolved
- `6` — a selected artifact or placement path is permission denied
- `7` — a valid --check evaluation contains available changes
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `undo`

Reverse the latest eligible retained operation for selected placements

Primary question: How do I abort or reverse a selected retained operation?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith undo <skill>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (preview): Preview reversal of the latest eligible factor-scan operation. — `skillsmith undo factor-scan --dry-run`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Reverse the Codex project placement for factor-scan. — `skillsmith undo factor-scan --tool codex --project`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Approve reversal of every eligible user-scope operation. — `skillsmith undo --all --scope user --yes`

#### Arguments

- `[skill...]` — Skill names whose latest eligible retained operations should be reversed

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all` — Select every eligible retained operation in the chosen scope
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict selection to a target tool; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Restrict selection to user or current-project scope
- `--user` — Select user-scope retained operations
- `--project` — Select current-project retained operations

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-y, --yes` — Approve the exact changing undo plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Render the exact undo plan without locking or writing
- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent undo groups after a failure
- `--json` — Emit the strict undo@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — selected work was previewed, already reversed, filtered to no-op, or safely undone
- `1` — one or more selected reversals failed
- `2` — invalid target, --all, scope, approval, or option usage
- `3` — selected history, retained state, ledger, or execution guard is invalid
- `4` — a selected tool does not support the required undo capability
- `6` — a selected retained artifact or placement path is permission denied
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


## DEVELOP

### `dev`

Demote a pinned skill back to a live development source.

Aliases: `demote`

Primary question: How do I use a local checkout as the live development source?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith dev <skill> --source <path>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Return factor-scan to its recorded live development source. — `skillsmith dev factor-scan`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Adopt an explicit local checkout as the gh-fix-ci development source. — `skillsmith dev gh-fix-ci --tool codex --source ~/c/gh-fix-ci/skills/gh-fix-ci`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Roll back the latest eligible factor-scan development operation. — `skillsmith dev --rollback factor-scan`

#### Arguments

- `[skill...]` — Skill names or placement paths

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all` — Demote every pinned placement with a recorded dev source
- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--scope <scope>` — Restrict selection to user or current-project placements
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict to tools; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--dest <path>` — Destination root for a created placement; requires one --tool
- `--source <path>` — Create or adopt a placement from this development source

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--no-verify` _(advanced)_ — Skip the static verify gate on create or adopt
- `--rollback` _(advanced)_ — Undo the last dev flip or recover an interrupted one
- `--strict` — Treat verify warnings as blocking on create or adopt

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `--yes` — Approve one planned bulk demotion without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent groups after a failure
- `--dry-run` — Show the plan without changing anything
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — demoted, or already in dev mode
- `1` — placement flip failed; state is recoverable
- `2` — usage error or refusal, including a missing recorded source
- `3` — placements ledger is unreadable
- `4` — requested skill or tool has no placement
- `5` — recorded development source no longer exists
- `6` — skills directory or ledger is not writable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT; state is recoverable


### `verify`

Verify that a plugin loads under each target tool

Primary question: Is this skill or plugin valid for the selected tools?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith verify <path>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (read-only): Verify one bare skill directory. — `skillsmith verify ./skills/review`
- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Run deep, strict verification for a plugin directory. — `skillsmith verify ./plugin --deep --strict`

#### Arguments

- `<path>` — Plugin or bare skill directory

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict to tools; repeatable; default: all detected

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--deep` — Also run isolated native load verification (no model call)
- `--static` _(advanced)_ — Run static verification only; this is the default
- `--strict` — Treat warnings as failures (exit 1 on any warning)

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — verification passed
- `1` — verification failed or strict mode found warnings
- `2` — path or option usage is invalid
- `4` — requested target tool or verification mode is unavailable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT

- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user

- `--yes` — Approve one planned bulk promotion without prompting

- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent groups after a failure
- `--dry-run` — Show the plan without changing anything
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

- `0` — promoted, or already pinned

- `3` — placements ledger is unreadable

## DECLARATIVE

### `init`

Create or safely migrate one desired-state manifest

Primary question: How do I create or migrate the desired-state file?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith init`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Create or migrate the default desired-state manifest. — `skillsmith init`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Initialize a project manifest bounded to Codex. — `skillsmith init --project --tool codex`
- **Advanced workflow** (preview): Preview an explicit team manifest and emit JSON. — `skillsmith init --file ./team.toml --dry-run --json`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Persist a writable tool default; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Persist user or project scope and select its default destination
- `--user` — Initialize the user manifest and persist user scope
- `--project` — Initialize the current project manifest and persist project scope

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Initialize one explicit desired-state manifest

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Back up and replace only the selected existing manifest

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Preview the exact manifest operation without writing
- `--json` — Emit the strict init@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — manifest initialized, migrated, unchanged, or previewed
- `1` — manifest execution or detection failed
- `2` — invalid selection or unrepresentable configured path
- `3` — configuration, existing manifest, or concurrent state is invalid
- `4` — selected tool or scope is not writable by init
- `6` — manifest or parent permission denied
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `export`

Capture portable live skill state in a manifest and lockfile

Primary question: How do I capture the current fleet as portable desired state?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith export`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Capture the default live fleet in portable desired state. — `skillsmith export`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Write project-scoped desired state to an explicit manifest. — `skillsmith export --project --file ./skillsmith.toml`
- **Advanced workflow** (preview): Preview a strict Claude Code export without writing files. — `skillsmith export --tool claude-code --strict --dry-run`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Read one tool inventory; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Read one scope; default: project in project context, otherwise user
- `--user` — Read user placements and select the user pair
- `--project` — Read current-project placements and select the project pair
- `--system` — Read system placements as nonportable observations
- `--managed` — Read policy-managed placements as nonportable observations

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Write one explicit portable manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Write one explicit lockfile (requires --file)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--strict` — Fail without writes when any selected observation is nonportable

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Resolve only bounded selected declaration conflicts

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command
- `--dry-run` — Preview artifact effects without locking or writing
- `--json` — Emit the strict export@1 report

#### Exit codes

- `0` — portable export completed or no portable rows remained
- `1` — strict portability or execution failure
- `2` — invalid selection or unresolved declaration conflict
- `3` — artifact or ledger state is invalid or stale
- `4` — required readable tool capability is unavailable
- `6` — artifact or ledger permission denied
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `plan`

Preview desired/current convergence without changing selected state

#### Common workflows

- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Plan project convergence including safe pruning. — `skillsmith plan --project --prune`
- **Advanced workflow** (read-only): Check locked convergence for drift and emit JSON. — `skillsmith plan --locked --check --json`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict planning to a target tool; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Restrict planning to user or project scope
- `--user` — Plan user-scope convergence
- `--project` — Plan current-project convergence

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Read one explicit desired-state manifest
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Read one explicit lockfile (requires --file)
- `--out <path>` _(advanced)_ — Create one canonical saved-plan v1 artifact

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--locked` _(advanced)_ — Require every selected lock entry to be current
- `--prune` _(advanced)_ — Include bounded managed removals inside the selected authority
- `--check` — Exit 7 when the valid preview contains drift

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Atomically replace only the selected saved-plan output

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--json` — Emit the strict plan-report@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — valid convergence preview completed
- `1` — planning or saved-output execution failed
- `2` — invalid selection, option policy, or output request
- `3` — manifest, lock, ledger, or selected state is invalid or stale
- `4` — a required planner capability is unavailable
- `5` — a selected source could not be resolved
- `6` — a selected path could not be read or written due to permissions
- `7` — a valid --check preview contains drift
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `apply`

Converge live skill state from a manifest or exact reviewed saved plan

Primary question: How do I execute the reviewed convergence plan?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith apply`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (changes-state): Converge live state from the default manifest. — `skillsmith apply`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Converge project state including safe pruning. — `skillsmith apply --project --prune`
- **Advanced workflow** (preview): Preview an exact previously reviewed saved plan. — `skillsmith apply --plan review.skillsmith.plan --dry-run`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict fresh convergence to a target tool; repeatable
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Restrict fresh convergence to user or project scope
- `--user` — Converge user-scope desired state in fresh mode
- `--project` — Converge current-project desired state in fresh mode

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Read one explicit desired-state manifest in fresh mode
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Read one explicit lockfile in fresh mode (requires --file)
- `--plan <path>` _(advanced)_ — Validate or execute one exact reviewed saved-plan v1 artifact

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--locked` _(advanced)_ — Require every selected lock entry to be current in fresh mode
- `--prune` _(advanced)_ — Authorize bounded managed removals in fresh mode
- `--check` — Exit 7 when the valid exact plan contains changes

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-y, --yes` — Approve a changing fresh plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent fresh-plan groups after a failure
- `--dry-run` — Validate and render the exact plan without locking or writing
- `--json` — Emit the strict apply-report@1 report

#### Exit codes

- `0` — selected state converged, or an exact valid plan was empty or previewed
- `1` — execution, integrity, or partial convergence failed
- `2` — invalid selection, mode, approval, or option policy
- `3` — saved authorization or selected state is invalid, incompatible, or stale
- `4` — a required apply capability is unavailable
- `5` — a selected source could not be resolved
- `6` — a selected path could not be read or written due to permissions
- `7` — a valid --check plan contains changes
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `sync`

Converge one exact destination from one immutable live source

Primary question: How do I reconcile one live location into another?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith sync --from <A> --to <B>`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (preview): Preview a user-to-project-directory reconciliation. — `skillsmith sync --from user --to ./project-b --dry-run`
- **Focused workflow** (changes-state): Sync the lint skill between two projects for Codex. — `skillsmith sync lint --from ./project-a --to ./project-b --tool codex`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Approve user-to-project reconciliation including deletions. — `skillsmith sync --from user --to project --delete --yes`

#### Arguments

- `[skill...]` — Skill-name or glob filters; omitted means bounded source membership

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `-t, --tool <name>` — Restrict sync to a target tool; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--from <scope|path>` — Read the exact source scope or project path
- `--to <scope|path>` — Write the exact destination user scope or project path
- `--file <path>` — Select one destination manifest (requires --save)
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Select one destination lockfile (requires --file and --save)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--delete` _(advanced)_ — Remove exact selected destination-only placements
- `--save` _(advanced)_ — Update the selected destination manifest and lockfile pair

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-f, --force` _(advanced)_ — Back up and replace only selected destination conflicts
- `-y, --yes` — Approve a guarded sync plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Render the exact non-mutating sync plan
- `--continue-on-error` _(advanced)_ — Continue with later independent destination groups after a failure
- `--json` — Emit the strict sync@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — selected destination converged, was already current, filtered to no-op, or was previewed
- `1` — execution, integrity, or partial convergence failed
- `2` — invalid endpoint, selection, conflict, save, option, or approval policy
- `3` — selected artifact, ledger, or precondition state is invalid or stale
- `4` — a selected tool or destination sync capability is unavailable
- `6` — a selected destination or artifact path is permission denied
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


## MAINTAIN

### `doctor`

Diagnose SkillSmith and target-tool readiness

Primary question: What is unhealthy and what deterministic repair is available?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith doctor`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (read-only): Diagnose the current SkillSmith environment. — `skillsmith doctor`
- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Run strict readiness diagnostics for every supported tool. — `skillsmith doctor --all-tools --strict`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all-tools` _(advanced)_ — Diagnose every known tool instead of the configured default
- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--system` — Shorthand for --scope=system
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Limit checks to a scope
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Limit checks to tools; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Use an explicit desired-state file
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Use an explicit lockfile (requires --file)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--fix` _(advanced)_ — Repair the closed set of safely repairable artifact findings
- `--offline` _(advanced)_ — Skip network checks
- `--strict` — Treat warnings as failures

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-y, --yes` — Approve the complete automatic repair plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Preview automatic repairs without changing artifacts
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — diagnostics completed without blocking findings
- `1` — unhandled findings or repair failures remain
- `2` — invalid selection, option policy, or repair approval
- `3` — artifact state is invalid, corrupt, newer, or stale
- `5` — source resolution required for repair failed
- `6` — a selected repair path is not writable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `check`

Error-severity subset of doctor, suitable for CI

Primary question: Are blocking machine/project health checks passing?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith check`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (read-only): Run the blocking health subset suitable for CI. — `skillsmith check`
- **Focused workflow** (read-only): Emit all-tool blocking health results as JSON. — `skillsmith check --all-tools --json`

#### TARGETS AND SCOPE

- `--all-tools` _(advanced)_ — Check every known tool instead of the configured default
- `--project` — Shorthand for --scope=project
- `--system` — Shorthand for --scope=system
- `--user` — Shorthand for --scope=user
- `-s, --scope <scope>` — Limit checks to a scope
- `-t, --tool <name>` — Limit checks to tools; repeatable

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--file <path>` — Use an explicit desired-state file
- `--lockfile <path>` _(advanced)_ — Use an explicit lockfile (requires --file)

#### BEHAVIOR AND VERIFICATION

- `--report-only` _(advanced)_ — Report errors without failing the process

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--exit-code` _(advanced)_ — Deprecated; check already exits non-zero on error findings
- `--json` — Emit a versioned JSON report on stdout
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — blocking checks passed, or --report-only was used
- `1` — one or more error findings exist
- `2` — invalid tool, scope, artifact, or exit-policy selection
- `3` — configuration is unreadable
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT


### `gc`

Reclaim unreachable local store objects under exact safety guards

Primary question: Which unreachable local store objects can be reclaimed?

Minimal invocation: `skillsmith gc`

#### Common workflows

- **Start here** (preview): Preview every currently eligible store reclamation. — `skillsmith gc --dry-run`
- **Focused workflow** (preview): Preview objects older than 30 days and emit JSON. — `skillsmith gc --older-than 30d --dry-run --json`
- **Advanced workflow** (changes-state): Approve forgetting a retired project before reclamation. — `skillsmith gc --forget-project /workspace/retired --yes`

#### SOURCE, DESTINATION, AND ARTIFACTS

- `--forget-project <path>` _(advanced)_ — Forget one exact missing registered project before reachability analysis; repeatable
- `--older-than <duration>` _(advanced)_ — Select only objects strictly older than this duration

#### SAFETY AND APPROVAL

- `-y, --yes` — Approve the exact changing GC plan without prompting

#### AUTOMATION AND OUTPUT

- `--dry-run` — Preview the exact GC plan without locks or writes
- `--json` — Emit the strict gc@1 report
- `-h, --help` — Show help for this command

#### Exit codes

- `0` — GC was previewed, completed, or already converged
- `1` — one or more approved GC actions failed
- `2` — invalid duration, forget request, option, or approval policy
- `3` — ledger, inventory, recovery, tombstone, or execution state is unsafe
- `6` — a selected state path is permission denied
- `130` — cancelled by SIGINT
